payload.tension: The passage states love fulfills what is owed to another. Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law. Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
